**STATUS:** ok

**SUMMARY:** Added a confirmed "Clear all" action to the Android Events tab. `RawEventDao.deleteAll()` (`DELETE FROM raw_events`) removes every captured event; existing Room `ForeignKey.CASCADE` on `normalized_transactions.sourceEventId` and `delivery_records.sourceEventId` cleans up associated rows (queued/failed/sent all included), so no migration or schema change was needed. `MaintenanceRepository.clearAll()` and `EventActions.clearAll()` pass the action through untouched; settings and `dedup_cache` are never touched. `EventsScreen` now renders "Clear all" beside "Clear processed" and gates it behind an `AlertDialog` whose copy explicitly warns that queued and failed deliveries that have not reached Go Money are included and the action cannot be undone; `MainActivity` wires `onClearAll` through the existing coroutine scope. A new repository test proves clear all removes raw events, normalized transactions, and delivery records across sent/pending/failed states; the two pre-existing clear-processed tests were left unchanged and still pass. All existing uncommitted work in the working tree was preserved (edits were additive only).

**Files changed:**
- `android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/gomoney/capture/storage/Daos.kt` — added `RawEventDao.deleteAll()`
- `android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/gomoney/capture/storage/MaintenanceRepository.kt` — added `clearAll()`
- `android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/gomoney/capture/ui/EventActions.kt` — added `clearAll()`
- `android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/gomoney/capture/ui/EventsScreen.kt` — added `onClearAll` param, "Clear all" button, and confirmation dialog
- `android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/gomoney/capture/ui/MainActivity.kt` — wired `onClearAll`
- `android/app/src/test/kotlin/com/gomoney/capture/storage/MaintenanceRepositoryTest.kt` — added `clear all removes every event across states and cascades children` test

**Tests run:** `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "com.gomoney.capture.storage.MaintenanceRepositoryTest"` (pass), then full `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest` suite (pass). No commits, pushes, or deploys; specs/backend untouched.
